tagline.cn: 你是外籍旅客。錢、精神、簽證時間、手機電量、本地化——五條命一起走。
tagline.en: You're a foreign traveler. Money, sanity, visa time, phone battery, and locality — five lives at once.

body.cn: 抵達香港並完成「離境口岸」。好結局會依屬性分檔：本地通（Locality≥80）＞省錢大師（餘額≥1500）＞樂天派（Sanity≥80）＞普通生還離境。離境不再因當天扣 24h 被誤判壞結局。
body.en: Reach Hong Kong and finish Exit Border. Good endings tier by stats: Local Pro (Locality≥80) > Thrifty Master (money≥1500) > Optimist (Sanity≥80) > Survived Exit. Exit no longer falsely triggers the time Bad End.

body.cn: Sanity、剩餘簽證時間、或電量任一歸零 → Bad End。144 小時簽證尤其吃緊：每個景點約消耗一天（24h）。
body.en: If Sanity, remaining visa time, or Battery hits 0 → Bad End. 144-hour visas are especially tight: each attraction costs about one day (24h).

body.cn: 選簽證 → 北京新手教程 → 城市景點地圖（一針=一天）→ 城際交通換城 → 最終衝香港離境。
body.en: Pick a visa → Beijing tutorial → city attraction map (one pin = one day) → intercity travel → push to Hong Kong exit.

stats.cn: Money：景點、交通、住宿、急救都會花錢；景點內💰選項可賺錢（需 Sanity ≥ 70）。
stats.en: Money: attractions, travel, lodging, and emergencies cost RMB. 💰 hustles inside pins can earn cash (needs Sanity ≥ 70).

stats.cn: Sanity：排隊、支付失靈、文化衝擊會掉；湖景/茶館/慢旅行可回血；住宿越好過夜回復越多。
stats.en: Sanity: queues, payment fails, and culture shock drain it; lakes/tea/slow travel restore it; better lodging restores more overnight.

stats.cn: Time：簽證剩餘小時。完成景點約 -24h，再加城際交通耗時。時間到 = 簽證壓力 Bad End。
stats.en: Time: remaining visa hours. Finishing a pin ≈ -24h, plus intercity travel. Hit 0 = visa-pressure Bad End.

stats.cn: Battery：導航、翻譯、掃碼都耗電。當天電量 > 0 過夜可回電解；也可掃共享充電寶（需移動支付）。
stats.en: Battery: maps, translate apps, and QR scans drain it. Survive the day with battery > 0 for overnight charge; shared power banks need mobile pay.

stats.cn: Locality：你有多「會活在中國」。辦號、綁支付、識破陷阱會漲；現金死磕/被宰會掉。影響部分選項與香港結局檔位。
stats.en: Locality: how well you operate in China. SIMs, mobile pay, and spotting scams raise it; cash stubbornness / getting scammed lowers it. Gates some choices and your Hong Kong ending tier.

items.cn: 教程裡的選擇會留下 flags（有國內號／現金硬剛等），後面城市選項會因此鎖定或解鎖。
items.en: Tutorial choices leave flags (local number / cash-only, etc.) that lock or unlock later options.

items.cn: 沙發客只能湊合一晚；換城或到期後要先安排住宿才能繼續點景點。
items.en: Couch stays last one night. After expiry or city changes, arrange lodging before more pins.

items.cn: 地圖上部分城市要先通關前置城；西藏/新疆還受簽證限制。
items.en: Some cities need prerequisite visits; Tibet/Xinjiang also have visa restrictions.

items.cn: 下方 Debug / Status Monitor 可查看 flags 與階段；英文介面時會顯示英文標籤。
items.en: The Debug / Status Monitor below shows flags and step; labels follow your language toggle.
